title: Leaving the simulator
concept: Install real git; rehearse day one on your own machine

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: You have finished. Everything you typed here is real git syntax.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Let me be straight with you about what was pretend.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: The website was pretend. Sam and Priya were pretend. Sign-in was pretend.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: The commands, the messages and the three boxes were not. Those are the real thing.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: On a real computer: install git from git-scm.com, then open a terminal.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Your very first two commands on any new machine set your name and email.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Let us rehearse that exact sequence one last time, then you are done.

items.text: Set your name and email, like on a fresh machine
Make a folder, start a repository in it, and make the first commit
Answer: what carries over to a real terminal?
Answer: what is the one thing to do differently out there?

hints: Do what you would do on a brand new computer: identity, folder, repository, first commit.
`git config --global user.name`, `git config --global user.email`, `mkdir`, `cd`, `git init`, then add and commit a file.

`git config --global user.name "Your Name"`, `git config --global user.email "you@example.com"`, `mkdir my-project`, `cd my-project`, `echo "hello" > README.md`, `git add README.md`, `git commit -m "My first commit"`.

questions.prompt: Which of these works exactly the same in a real terminal?

choices.text: Only the simple commands like git status
Every git command you typed here, and the messages git printed back
Nothing: this was only a game

questions.explanation: The commands and git's wording were matched to real git on purpose. The pretend parts were the website, the teammates and the sign-in.

questions.prompt: What is genuinely different on a real computer?

choices.text: You sign in to the hosting site once in your browser, and there is no Rewind button

questions.explanation: Real git has no rewind. That is why `git status` before acting, and small commits, matter so much.

recap: Real git is the same commands you already know. Install it, set user.name and user.email once, and remember there is no Rewind button out there: check git status before you act.

cheatSheet.summary: First thing to run on any new computer
